cases.request: Implement the accepted spec and run the nearest validation.
cases.notes: Implementation request from an accepted spec should stay in the active workspace.

cases.request: Apply the reviewed findings to the code with the smallest scoped edit.
cases.notes: Accepted review findings are an implementation input.

cases.request: Fix the blocker in the target files and report validation coverage.
cases.notes: Fixing a blocker in files is scoped implementation.

cases.request: Make the config change from the approved plan, but do not commit.
cases.notes: Mutation is allowed only as scoped workspace implementation.

cases.request: Update the script according to the accepted design plan.
cases.notes: Accepted design plan plus code change matches implementation.

cases.request: Draft a compact implementation spec for a context-load smoke eval.
cases.notes: Spec drafting request should use the Knitten Core spec shape and path rules.

cases.request: Write a pre-work plan before editing the skill files.
cases.notes: Pre-work plan before edits maps to draft spec.

cases.request: Create an implementation contract with goal, boundary, validation, and acceptance criteria.
cases.notes: Implementation contract is a drafting task.

cases.request: Make a design plan for updating a skill match check.
cases.notes: Skill-related design plan should keep match policy visible.

cases.request: Triad review the prepared packet and report blocker findings only.
cases.notes: Prepared packet plus triad review matches read-only review.

cases.request: Run a single read-only review from this source-cited target packet.
cases.notes: Single review is supported by the same review reference.

cases.request: Review this implementation diff without editing files.
cases.notes: Explicit read-only review should not match implementation.

cases.request: Find P0-P2 blockers in the supplied review target.
cases.notes: Blocker review of a supplied target is review work.

cases.request: Record this checked stale plugin cache finding with reproduction notes.
cases.notes: Checked mechanical plugin/cache failure belongs in finding capture.

cases.request: Log a doctor failure finding after confirming the missing config path.
cases.notes: Doctor and missing-path failures are reportable mechanical findings.

cases.request: Save a structured finding for a reproducible validator failure.
cases.notes: Validator failure with evidence matches finding capture.

cases.request: What is the weather in Seoul today?
cases.notes: Weather request is outside the evaluated Knitten Core pilot skills.

cases.request: Commit and push the current repository changes.
cases.notes: Commit/push is not one of the evaluated Knitten Core pilot skills.

cases.request: Generate an image of a product mockup.
cases.notes: Image generation is outside the evaluated Knitten Core pilot skills.

cases.request: Install a new Codex plugin from a GitHub repository.
cases.notes: Plugin installation is not part of the Knitten Core smoke eval pilot set.
